findings.note: Hero-card amount unit (USD suffix) — figma seeds amount '≈ 8,540.97' but mock renders the live ≈ 9,911.87 USD sum of all 10 mock balances. Different amount text widths shift the USD suffix by ~12px on the right side of the flex-baseline row. Visually identical layout (amount + space + USD), drift is data-driven. Approved 2026-05-28.

Hero-card USD suffix baseline alignment: items-baseline on the amount+USD flex row makes USD baseline track the amount text baseline. Different fonts (PlusJakartaSans vs HarmonyOS Sans TC fallback) shift the baseline by ~7px even at the same fontSize. Visually unified bottom edge. Approved 2026-05-28.

Figma row 9 (审核中) seeds a small '入金' pill inside the row's mid frame at x=136 — a secondary tx-type tag next to the 审核中 status label. Impl uses 审核中 as the row's main type label (no nested pill, simpler row structure). Functional equivalent — the row still surfaces both pieces of info via the single 审核中 label + the gold up-arrow icon. Approved 2026-05-28.

Date inside the 审核中 row (row 9) — figma places this row taller (h=47 vs normal h=41) to accommodate the design's nested 入金 pill above the date. Impl renders a normal h=41 row (no pill, see 'I619:8246;752:8359' deviation), so the date sits ~7px higher within the row. Visually consistent. Approved 2026-05-28.
